notes: The gte and lte ladders are deliberately different lengths: the negative side truncates at the total-loss floor because every summarized metric is a return ratio and cannot pass -1.
Bucket closure convention: negative values fall right-closed (lo, hi]; non-negative values fall left-closed [lo, hi). This makes every threshold count an exact partial sum of bucket counts.
present + absent equals the occurrence total for every metric. An absent outcome is counted, never implied to be zero.
Rates come from outcomes_summary over all occurrences; page rows are examples, never the denominator.
Any change to this descriptor is a result-encoding bump, because these lists join the serving cache and ETag keys.
